descriptions.d24i_string_replace_all_801099a4: Replace every occurrence of one text in a shared string: builds engine strings for the search and replacement texts, reads the search length from its header, and for each strstr match rebuilds a local string from the prefix (0x8020c048), the replacement and the remainder (0x8020bf2c), shares it back into the target with reference counting, then destroys the three local strings.
